descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S06 Temperature boundaries through Save Note's extraction: bare °C stays °C, nothing converted

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 A bare Celsius temperature stays in °C (PR #48); no unit is guessed for an ambiguous value. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 6; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Five dictations with one temperature each, across the ≤ 45 (°C) and ≥ 90 (°F) bands main uses, plus a bare weight

When Each dictation goes through ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes with the app's context and client guards

Then The stored temperature keeps the dictated number; a bare Celsius number is never labelled or converted to °F; a bare Fahrenheit number is not converted to °C; the bare weight gets no unit

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per case fieldIncludes / fieldNotIncludes / displayNotIncludes on vitals.temp and vitals.wt; all 5 must pass (deterministic expectation on dictated numbers). Reported as 'model + exported guards', not as the app's write path

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
